models.federations: Array of umbrella organizations that coordinate multiple child associations under unified governance structures.
models.childAssociations: Associations linked to a federation as chapters, each retaining operational independence while sharing governance standards.
models.leaders: Federation leadership team with assigned roles, permissions, and term dates.
models.policies: Governance policies created at the federation level that cascade to child associations with configurable enforcement levels.
models.funds: Federation-level fund accounts for managing shared financial resources across all child associations.
models.duesInvoices: Individual dues invoices sent to child associations with payment status tracking.
models.transfers: Financial transfers and grants between the federation and child associations with multi-approval workflows.
models.elections: Federation-wide elections for leadership positions and referendums with nomination and voting periods.
models.candidates: Candidates nominated for federation elections with statements and endorsement counts.
models.events: Federation-wide events targeting multiple associations with RSVP and attendance tracking per chapter.
models.announcements: Federation-wide announcements broadcast to all or selected child associations.
models.reports: Generated federation reports (AGM, financial, membership) with export and scheduling options.
models.alerts: Dashboard alerts for threshold breaches, compliance issues, and action items requiring federation leadership attention.
models.aggregatedMembers: Consolidated member directory entries across all child associations with cross-membership indicators.
models.complianceItems: Compliance tracking for each child association against federation policies.
models.duesConfigs: Configuration for federation dues collected from child associations, including invoicing rules and payment tracking. One per federation.
models.budgets: Annual budgets with categorized allocations and actual spending tracked against approved amounts. One per federation per year.
models.cashFlowHistories: 12-month rolling cash flow entries per federation, showing monthly income and expenses.

federations.name: Swiss African Diaspora Federation
federations.description: A coordinating body for African diaspora associations across Switzerland, promoting financial inclusion, cultural preservation, and community solidarity through shared governance and collaborative initiatives.

federations.name: European Filipino Community Federation
federations.description: A representative federation connecting Filipino community associations across Germany, fostering cultural heritage, mutual support, and economic empowerment through collective governance and shared resources.

policies.title: Minimum Trust Score for Circle Participation
policies.description: All child associations must enforce a minimum Trust Score of 500 for members joining ROSCA circles to reduce default risk across the federation.

policies.title: KYC Verification Standards
policies.description: Members holding treasurer or president roles in any child association must complete enhanced KYC verification (identity document + proof of address) within 30 days of role assignment.

policies.title: Emergency Fund Minimum Rate
policies.description: All ROSCA circles operating under federation associations should maintain a minimum emergency fund rate of 1.5% of contributions, above the platform default of 1%.

policies.title: Annual General Meeting Requirements
policies.description: Each child association must hold at least one Annual General Meeting per calendar year and submit meeting minutes to the federation within 14 days.

policies.title: Member Trust Score Requirement
policies.description: All members participating in ROSCA circles must maintain a minimum Trust Score of 550. Members below this threshold may observe but not participate in payouts.

policies.title: Cultural Event Participation Guidelines
policies.description: Each child association is encouraged to organize at least two cultural heritage events annually and participate in federation-wide celebrations.

policies.title: Financial Transparency Standards
policies.description: Draft policy requiring all child associations to publish quarterly financial summaries accessible to all members, with detailed reports submitted to the federation treasurer.

announcements.title: AGM 2025 Registration Now Open
announcements.content: Registration for the 2025 Annual General Meeting is now open. All association presidents and delegates are expected to attend. Please confirm your chapter's delegation by May 31.

announcements.title: Updated Emergency Fund Policy — Action Required
announcements.content: The federation board has approved an updated recommended minimum emergency fund rate of 1.5%. All associations are encouraged to review and adjust their circle settings. Non-compliant associations will be flagged in the next compliance review.

announcements.title: Congratulations to Lausanne Chapter on 15% Growth!
announcements.content: We celebrate the Pan-African Association Lausanne for achieving 15.6% membership growth this quarter — the highest in the federation. Their community outreach initiatives are a model for all chapters.

announcements.title: Annual Assembly Registration Deadline Extended
announcements.content: Due to high interest, we have extended the registration deadline for the 2025 Annual General Assembly to June 30. All chapter representatives are encouraged to register and participate in shaping our federation's future.

announcements.title: Welcome Frankfurt Chapter to the Federation
announcements.content: We are pleased to announce that Frankfurt Filipino Circle has completed its onboarding process and is now a full chapter member. Please join us in welcoming our newest community to the federation family!
